(root):
usage: evallab [-h] [--version]
               {doctor,dashboard,status,preflight,submit,tick,approve,reject,stop,resume,schedule,digest,nightly,research,canary,calibrate,run,matrix,summarize,ingest,trajectories,compare,power,report,analyze,db,lineage,analyst,card,behavior,ladder,trace,fetch,gc,registry,tidy,verdict}
               ...

Run, inspect, and analyze agent evaluations through Harbor.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,dashboard,status,preflight,submit,tick,approve,reject,stop,resume,schedule,digest,nightly,research,canary,calibrate,run,matrix,summarize,ingest,trajectories,compare,power,report,analyze,db,lineage,analyst,card,behavior,ladder,trace,fetch,gc,registry,tidy,verdict}
    doctor              Check local Harbor, Docker, uv, and PostgreSQL
    dashboard           Open the read-only research overview
    status              Read-only operator snapshot of recent work, health,
                        and saved analysis
    preflight           Read-only: remaining quota per provider, the queue by
                        purpose, power warnings
    submit              Validate and submit one experiment spec
    tick                Reconcile and drain the approved experiment queue
    approve             Authorize one queued experiment; required before any
                        billable agent runs
    reject              Reject one queued experiment
    stop                Stop dispatch after the current trial
    resume              Remove the queue stop marker
    schedule            Manage unattended launchd schedules
    digest              Render one daily digest from catalog and events
    nightly             Run the fail-closed unattended nightly cycle
    research            Run one guarded analyst/synthesizer/proposer pass
    canary              Manage version-pinned nightly canaries
    calibrate           Measure a judge against one sealed calibration family
    run                 Run one explicitly named Harbor job
    matrix              Run a checked-in JSON experiment matrix
    summarize           Print trial results directly from Harbor job
                        directories
    ingest              Upsert Harbor job metadata into PostgreSQL
    trajectories        Validate ATIF; optionally rebuild catalog and
                        deterministic Parquet facts
    compare             Compare declared trial cohorts
    power               Plan task-paired pass@k comparison power
    report              Render trajectory families and eval cards
    analyze             Plan or index bounded trial analyses
    db                  Manage the derived PostgreSQL index
    lineage             Trace recursive lineage of generated artifacts back to
                        Z1
    analyst             Run, list, and inspect durable trial analyses with
                        reasoning trajectories
    card                Generate and validate purpose-bound eval cards from
                        completed evidence
    behavior            Analyze agent execution behavior, effort, and
                        efficiency
    ladder              Expand Cartesian evaluation grids into ExperimentSpecs
    trace               Convert ATIF trajectories to OTel and ship them to
                        Phoenix
    fetch               Acquire a pinned Harbor Hub dataset into
                        library/benchmarks/
    gc                  Plan or apply compression/pruning of unpromoted
                        ingested runs
    registry            Inspect and audit explicit registered tasks
    tidy                Sweep working tree strays, stale worktrees, and
                        retention violations
    verdict             Record, list, or inspect append-only human verdicts on
                        discoveries

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
